== Published English Original Virtual Set 9 wording ==
The remaster explicitly permits forfeiting non-lightsaber weapons at 3 and returns a just-forfeited weapon to Used Pile. The earlier wording sends a weapon to Used Pile when lost. The free download and Alter immunity remain.
